1.

Sing, with all the heart sing And give praise to the Father! His way becomes clear and manifest To those who see Jesus.

2.

Through the heavens Our great High Priest has gone. In Him we, a company set free, Have received a glorious standing.

3.

Though still upon the earth Amid need and toils here, We walk in peace to dwell with God, Our home His presence is.

4.

And strengthened by our God In the day’s labour and strife, In the desert’s sand and barren land We journey onward in peace.

5.

Our way ever upward bears To life and salvation; There upward we go to partake In our Lord’s glory.

6.

Forever like the Lord, Forever near to Him, We shall clearly see His face And be where He is.
